note: Mutants derived from reindex_wrapper.py using classical mutation operators (SDL/ROR/COR/AOR/SVR). No LLM semantics involved.

mutants.behavior_broken: Row reindexing via index= keyword is silently ignored; DataFrame keeps original row index.
Column reindexing via columns= keyword is silently ignored; DataFrame keeps original columns.
Fill method (ffill/bfill/nearest) is dropped; all gaps remain NaN instead of being filled.
Custom fill_value is never forwarded; missing positions always receive NaN.
limit= is never forwarded; fill continues without restriction past the requested cap.
tolerance= is never forwarded; inexact matches succeed regardless of distance.
level= is never forwarded; MultiIndex level broadcast is lost.

mutants.target_line: if labels is not None: ... (entire block)
mutants.behavior_broken: Positional labels are silently dropped; reindex(labels, axis='columns') is a no-op.
Axis routing is reversed: labels intended for rows go to columns and vice versa.
Labels routing fires only when labels IS None; actual labels passed are silently ignored.
Index is forwarded only when it IS None (no-op); caller-supplied index values are ignored.
Columns are forwarded only when they IS None; caller-supplied columns are ignored.
fill_value forwarded only when it IS NaN (sentinel); custom values dropped. The 'not' is removed.
limit is inflated by 1 (limit + 1); one extra consecutive fill is performed beyond what was requested.
Default axis when axis=None is changed from 0 (rows) to 1 (columns); positional labels without explicit axis go to columns.
